request: Should we keep the v1 export endpoint?
facts: The v1 export endpoint was marked deprecated 14 months ago; v2 has replaced it.
Access logs show zero requests to v1 in the last 180 days.
Every known client has confirmed in writing that it moved to v2.
The v1 code is the only user of a library with a known, unpatched vulnerability.
The removal is one pull request, and reverting that pull request restores the endpoint.
note: The same decision asked as 'keep'. Keeping is the current state, so approve must mean the removal and the result is 'passed'. A result of 'rejected' means the proposal was framed as 'keep'.
